issues.title: Seven date formats across Payments
issues.detail: Dates switch format page to page and within one page: month-year only for past due dates ('Apr 2025', 'Dec 2025'), 'Sep 24, 2023' for past years on Wire Drawdowns, 'Sep 24, 2026' with the current year on ACH Authorizations while its own Flagged tab shows 'Sep 25', 'Mar 20, 2024' in the Checkbooks table but 'March 20' and 'September 24, 2026' in the check panel, 'September 24-25, 2026' on transfers, 'Wednesday, September 30th, 2026 at 5:00 PM' on check deposit success, and numeric '2/2/27' on the Taxes IRS deadline badge. Relative words appear next to absolute dates in the same panel: the approval panel says 'Requested by Alice C. on Sep 23' above 'Invoice date Yesterday' (the same day), the scheduled panel says 'on Sep 24' above 'Added on Today', and the batch reviewer shows 'Send on Tomorrow'. The Send recipient card reads 'Last paid on Sep 23, 2026' where the Recipients table shows 'Sep 23'.
issues.evidence: Rendered text: Payments inbox due dates 'Apr 2025' / 'Jan 17'; ACH list 'Sep 24, 2026' (current year) vs Flagged 'Sep 25' on the same page; check panel 'Date received: March 20' vs table 'Mar 20, 2024'; banner 'approved on September 24, 2026'; check success 'Wednesday, September 30th, 2026 at 5:00 PM' (ordinal); Taxes badge 'IRS Deadline 2/2/27'. Approval panel leaf texts: 'Requested by Alice C. on Sep 23' 14px/400 rgb(195,195,204) and 'Yesterday' 14px/400 rgb(221,221,229) (x2). Scheduled panel: 'Requested by Jane B. on Sep 24' and 'Today'.

issues.title: Check deposit flow swaps button components mid-flow
issues.detail: Steps 1-2 of check deposit use small 32px buttons with a ghost 'Go back'/'Back' and arrow (←/→) icons. Step 3 switches to a different button implementation at 40px with chevrons and a blue Back label. Send and Transfer use 40px buttons with a grey-filled Back and white text.
issues.evidence: Getting started: 'Go back' class _button_r6b2u_20 _small_r6b2u_72 _tertiary, h 32px, bg transparent, 15px/400; 'Got it' _primary h 32px, padding 4px 12px 4px 16px. Check images: 'Back' class _button-wrapper_1rzdg_13 _tertiary_1rzdg_76 _small_1rzdg_88, h 40px, color rgb(141,164,245). Send Amount: 'Back' h 40px, padding 8px 32px 8px 28px, bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), color rgb(221,221,229).

issues.title: Back button styled five different ways
issues.detail: The step-back action changes label, icon and fill from flow to flow: 'Go back' with no icon (Send recipient step, Invite/Create recipient, SAFE), 'Back' with chevron (Send amount onward, Transfer review, ACH), 'Back' with no icon (Transfer form, Wire drawdown), transparent tertiary 'Back' (Request payment link), and blue-text Back (Deposit payment details, check images).
issues.evidence: Transfer form Back: padding 8px 32px, 0 svg, color rgb(221,221,229); Send amount Back: padding 8px 32px 8px 28px, 1 svg; Request link Back: class _tertiary_r6b2u_153, bg rgba(0,0,0,0); Deposit Payment Details Back: color rgb(141,164,245), bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12), w 123px.

issues.title: Four different rules for when Next is disabled
issues.detail: Send and Transfer keep Next enabled and show inline errors on click. Check deposit and Order checkbook review hard-disable Next until the form is valid. Request money renders Next at 40% opacity but it still submits and shows errors. Wire drawdown starts disabled, enables after one choice, then disables again after an error.
issues.evidence: Request Next: disabled=false, class includes _appearDisabled_r6b2u_16, opacity 0.4, bg rgb(82,102,235). Check details Next: disabled attribute present. Wire drawdown Next: [disabled] on load, enabled after radio, [disabled] again after 'Please choose a recipient.'

issues.title: Validation messages mix trailing periods
issues.detail: Inline errors in the same form end with and without periods: Transfer shows 'Must be a dollar value.' above 'Please choose an account'; Create recipient shows 'You must make a selection.' above 'Please complete this field'. The wire bank-details errors use '#' shorthand and no period: 'Routing # should be a 9-digit number', 'Account # should be 4-17 characters'.
issues.evidence: Error text, all 12px/400 rgb(252,146,180): 'Must be a dollar value.', 'You must make a selection.', 'Please choose a recipient.', 'Please enter a valid US state.' vs 'Please complete this field', 'Please choose an account'. Wire errors 12px rgb(252,146,180): 'Routing # should be a 9-digit number', 'Account # should be 4-17 characters'. Re-measured Transfer: 'Must be a dollar value.' / 'Please choose an account'.

issues.title: Cents shown superscript in some places, inline in others
issues.detail: Tables use the money component with superscript cents, but the recipient panel's payments-by-year rows, the Checkbooks table, and the review/success hero amounts print cents inline. The Checkbooks table shows '$1,250.75' inline while its own detail panel shows the same amount with superscript cents. The batch reviewer shows '$6,042.95' with superscript cents, then its success page prints the $12,085.90 total inline; the approvals bulk bar also prints '$12,085.90 total' inline.
issues.evidence:
Recipients row: $1,205,329.91. Recipient panel: $1,203,984.72 (no superscript class). Checkbooks cell: plain $1,250.75 at 16px. Send review hero: _titleHero span '$250.00', 34px Arcadia Display, no child spans. Batch success:
$12,085.90
(no child spans). Bulk bar: $12,085.90 total.

issues.title: Success screens use three layouts
issues.detail: Send, Transfer and Check deposit share a left-aligned success page (34px H1 on rgb(16,16,26)). Request money uses a lighter rgb(54,54,68) themeWhite panel with a 28px H2 and says 'Return to dashboard' instead of 'Go to dashboard'. Order checkbook centers everything on a gradient. Adding an ACH authorization shows no confirmation at all. Bulk approval adds a fourth variant: centered column, 34px H1, a single 'Back to needs approval' CTA and no dashboard link.
issues.evidence: Send/Transfer success: _fullScreenWorkspaceLayout _success bg rgb(16,16,26), H1 34px Arcadia Display 380. Request success: _themeWhite_1x9rh_30 bg rgb(54,54,68), H2 28px. Checkbook success: H1 34px text-align center, background-image linear-gradient(... rgb(42,41,36) 30%). ACH: returns to /payments/authorizations with no toast. Batch success H1 'You've reviewed 2 payments' Arcadia Display 34px/380.

issues.title: Escape on the account picker abandons the payment
issues.detail: On the Send Amount step, pressing Escape while the 'Send from' account picker is open closes the whole flow and returns to /send-money/pay/start, discarding the entered amount. Escape on the Payment method listbox one step earlier only closes the list.
issues.evidence: Reproduced twice: URL /send-money/pay/amount, open 'Send from' (4 options), press Escape, URL becomes /send-money/pay/start. Same key on Payment method listbox (8 options) leaves URL at /send-money/pay/recipient-details.

issues.title: Back does nothing on deposit Payment Details; SAFE Go back leaves the flow
issues.detail: On /add-funds/wire the Back button does not navigate; only the 'Choose method' stepper link returns to deposit options. On Create a new SAFE, 'Go back' goes to /capital/safe instead of /add-funds.
issues.evidence: Clicked Back twice (ref and role lookup): URL stayed https://demo.mercury.com/add-funds/wire?account=party-mercurybankid2. SAFE 'Go back' landed on https://demo.mercury.com/capital/safe.

issues.title: Sibling forms use different column widths
issues.detail: Full-screen form columns vary with no pattern: Send flow 560px, Create recipient 584px, ACH authorization 522px, Invite recipient and Transfer fields 496px, Check deposit 424px. Create and Invite recipient are sister forms linked to each other yet differ by 88px.
issues.evidence: Measured input container widths: Invite recipient 496px, Create recipient 584px. Rendered column bounds from screenshots: Send 440-1000px (560), ACH add 459-981px (522), Check details 508-932px (424).

issues.title: W-8BEN spelled three ways
issues.detail: The same tax form appears as 'W-9/W-8 BEN' in the Recipients row action, 'W-8BEN' on the Invite toggle and the recipient panel, and 'W-9/W8-BEN' on the Tax Documents tab. The Request tax documents modal says 'W-8BENs', and the Request W-9s button on Taxes is lowercased to 'Request w-9s' under an H1 'Request W-9s'.
issues.evidence: Accessible names/text: button 'Download W-9/W-8 BEN'; switch 'Require tax documents (W-9 or W-8BEN)'; panel heading 'Tax documents (W-9 or W-8BEN)'; tab 'W-9/W8-BEN'. Button text on /taxes/1099-filing/2026/request-w9s: 'Request w-9s'.

issues.title: Title Case headings and actions mixed with sentence case
issues.detail: Most UI is sentence case, but these are Title Case: 'Request Tax Documents' (Create recipient; the Invite form says 'Require tax documents'), 'Payment Details' next to 'Tax documents' in the same recipient panel, 'Send Payment' toast action, 'View All', 'Order Checkbook' / 'Order a Checkbook', 'Payment Details' and 'View More Details' on Deposit, '+ Add Account', 'Learn More About SAFE Types', and the placeholder 'Recipient Name'. More in this pass: 'Review Requests' on the approvals bar next to 'Request tax docs' on the recipients bar; 'Export 2 Recipients' vs 'Export all' / 'Export filtered'; the 1099 payee panel pairs 'Remove Filing' with 'Edit filing'; the Taxes task list says 'Edit Filing' while every table row says 'Edit filing'; 'Edit Sarah Invalid State's Filing' and 'Payee Details' headings.
issues.evidence: Recipient panel: 'Payment Details' DIV 15px/400 rgb(244,245,249) and 'Tax documents (W-9 or W-8BEN)' SPAN 15px/400 rgb(244,245,249), identical styling but different casing. '+ Add Account' puts a literal '+' in the label where other add actions use an icon ('Add line item', 'Create recipient'). Buttons on /taxes/1099/filing/2026: 4x 'Edit Filing' + 21x 'Edit filing'. Payee panel: 'Remove Filing' and 'Edit filing', both h32 13.33px, text-transform none. Approvals bar 'Review Requests' h32 13.33px/360 pad 4px 12px 4px 16px; recipients bar 'Request tax docs' h32 13.33px/360 pad 4px 16px.

issues.title: Same status and method named differently
issues.detail: Recipients call it 'Pending details'; the Scheduled tab calls it 'Details pending'. The Scheduled tab abbreviates 'Intl. Wire' where the payment method list says 'International Wire'. The request preview says 'Pay With Mercury' while the methods list on the same page says 'Pay with Mercury'.
issues.evidence: Badge text 'Pending details' (class _badge_1u6of_4 _pearl) vs 'Details pending'; Method cell 'Intl. Wire'; leaf texts on the Request page: 'Pay with Mercury' and 'Pay With Mercury'.

issues.title: Business-day ranges punctuated four ways
issues.detail: Delivery estimates use a hyphen ('0-1 business days'), an en dash ('Arrives in 1–2 business days.'), words ('Appears in 1 to 5 business days.'), and a spaced hyphen ('1 - 5 business days', '10 - 14 business days').
issues.evidence: Rendered strings: send method '0-1 business days'; deposit cards 'Arrives in 1–2 business days.' / 'Appears in 1 to 5 business days.'; check guidelines 'take 1 - 5 business days'; checkbook 'Shipping est. 10 - 14 business days'.

issues.title: Recipient row icon links have no accessible name
issues.detail: The send and transactions icons at the end of each Recipients row are anchors with no text, aria-label, title or SVG title, so screen readers announce 'link' only.
issues.evidence: a[href='/send-money/pay/recipient-details']: aria-label null, aria-labelledby null, title null, textContent '', svg <title> none. Snapshot lists them as unnamed 'link' elements.

issues.title: Wrong closing quote around company name
issues.detail: Check deposit instructions and the back-of-check confirmation close “Mercury Demo, Incorporated“ with an opening quote glyph.
issues.evidence: Character after 'Incorporated' is U+201C (left double quote) instead of U+201D; the next phrase “For mobile deposit only” closes correctly.

issues.title: One label in the wire details list is brighter
issues.detail: In Domestic Transfer Details, 'Bank Name' renders in the value color while every other label in the list is muted grey.
issues.evidence: 'Beneficiary Name' / 'Account Number' labels: 15px/400 rgb(157,157,168); 'Bank Name' label: 15px/400 rgb(221,221,229).

issues.title: Some full-screen overlays hide the demo banner
issues.detail: Edit recipient details and Order a Checkbook render above the 'Explore the Mercury Demo / Viewing as Admin' banner, while every other full-screen flow sits below it.
issues.evidence: On /checkbooks/ordering/order, elementFromPoint(720,28) returns _rightPanel_j8648_20 (the overlay) instead of the demo banner; the banner is visible at y=0-56 on Send, Transfer and Deposit flows.

issues.title: Account numbers masked inconsistently
issues.detail: Review screens mask account numbers as '••1038', but the Transfer review shows the Treasury destination as a full 'Treasury 3713286', and Send review shows the recipient's full 'Account no. 99990101' after the Recipient step masked it as '••0101'.
issues.evidence: Transfer review: 'Account Ops / Payroll Checking ••1038' vs 'Account Treasury 3713286'. Send: recipient step 'Account ••0101 · Routing ••6789', review 'Account no. 99990101', 'Routing no. 123456789'.

issues.title: Stepper labels differ from page headings
issues.detail: Check deposit's stepper says 'Check images' while the page heading says 'Upload pictures'; the wire drawdown stepper says 'Funding account' while the heading says 'Source account'.
issues.evidence: Stepper item 'Check images' (active) above H1 'Upload pictures'; stepper 'Funding account' above heading 'Source account'.

issues.title: Wire drawdown funding step has no accounts
issues.detail: The drawdown flow's Source account select reads 'There are no accounts', so Next cannot proceed, although every other account picker lists Ops / Payroll, AP, AR, Checking and Savings.
issues.evidence: combobox 'Source account' value 'There are no accounts'; Next rendered disabled. Send from picker on the same session lists 4+ accounts.

issues.title: Date picker popover covers its own field
issues.detail: The Send on calendar opens 24px left of the form column and 48px above the field, covering the input it edits.
issues.evidence: Field container left 440px, top ~508px; popover left 416px, top 460px, width 370px, radius 12px, bg rgb(39,39,53).

issues.title: Approved row in Flagged table shifts 2px
issues.detail: The approved PG&E row replaces the checkbox with a check icon, and its cells shift 2px left of the rows above.
issues.evidence: 'Sep 25' cell left edges: 400px, 400px, 400px, then 398px on the approved row (tops 351/404/457/510).

issues.title: Status filter label is truncated copy
issues.detail: The Payments Status filter offers 'Due next 7' without a unit.
issues.evidence: Checkbox labels: 'Overdue', 'Due next 7', 'Not due yet', 'Missing due date'.

issues.title: Declining a payment skips the confirmation that canceling gets
issues.detail: Decline in the approval panel removes the request at once and shows a toast with a green success check. Canceling a scheduled payment, a similar destructive action, opens a 'Cancel recurring payment' confirmation modal first. The Decline button is also pink-tinted in the panel but neutral grey in the batch reviewer.
issues.evidence: Clicked Decline on the 'No due date' Jason Green request: Needs Approval count went 6 to 5 with no dialog, toast 'Request declined' with green check. Cancel payment opened dialog 'Cancel recurring payment' with Go back / Cancel payment (bg rgba(252,146,180,0.2), color rgb(252,146,180)). Batch reviewer Decline: bg rgba(180,183,200,0.12).

issues.title: Approval and update toasts word the same outcome differently
issues.detail: Approving from the panel says 'Request approved'; approving in the batch reviewer says 'Approved'. Editing a scheduled payment says 'Payment(s) updated' with a parenthetical plural, while tax requests say 'Tax documents requested from 1 recipient'.
issues.evidence: Toast strings observed: 'Request approved', 'Approved', 'Request declined', 'Payment canceled', 'Payment(s) updated', 'Tax documents requested from 1 recipient'.

issues.title: Foreign-currency amounts use a dollar sign with a currency suffix
issues.detail: Scheduled CAD and ARS payments render as '−$2,646.40 CAD' and '−$410.40 ARS', putting a $ in front of Argentine pesos. The cancel modal for the same CAD payment drops both the minus and the $: '2,646.40 CAD'. The edit review modal for a USD payment keeps both: '−$975.00'.
issues.evidence: Scheduled rows: '−$2,646.40 CAD', '−$410.40 ARS'. Cancel modal leaf texts: '2,646.40 CAD' (x2). Edit review rows: '−$975.00'.

issues.title: Editing one scheduled payment clears every due date
issues.detail: After confirming an amount change on one recurring payment, every row in the Scheduled table loses its due date and switches to a 'No due date' badge. Before the edit the rows showed Nov 1, Dec 1, Apr 2027, Nov 26 and Jun 2027 with 'Not due yet'.
issues.evidence: Table rows after Confirm: '– | Oct 5 | Recurring | No due date | Lighthouse Properties #3431', '– | Oct 30 | No due date | Domestic Ads', '– | Mar 2027 | Recurring | No due date | Nutritionist', ... Before: 'Nov 1 | Oct 1 | Recurring | Not due yet | Lighthouse Properties #3431'.

issues.title: Recurring payment progress disagrees with its cancel summary
issues.detail: The scheduled panel shows Progress '5 of 6' for the weekly CAD payment, but the cancel modal lists one remaining payment and says the rule runs 'until 6 payments are made'. The panel badge says 'Monthly' while the edit form's Repeat field reads 'Custom'.
issues.evidence: Panel: 'Progress 5 of 6'. Modal: 'Exchange USD to CAD at rates on day of transfer and pay weekly on Thursday until 6 payments are made.', '1 payment total 2,646.40 CAD'. Lighthouse panel badge 'Monthly'; combobox 'Repeat' value 'Custom'.

issues.title: Tax request modal silently drops selected recipients
issues.detail: With two recipients selected, the bar says '2 recipients selected' but the Request tax documents modal says 'from 1 recipient' and lists only Debug LLC, without saying why Nutritionist was left out. A tooltip later reads 'Selection does not include recipients eligible for tax document requests'.
issues.evidence: Bar label '2 recipients selected' 15px/400; modal subtitle 'Get W-9s and W-8BENs from 1 recipient via email.'; tooltip text 'Selection does not include recipients eligible for tax document requests'.

issues.title: Empty bulk-action bar covers the 1099 filing form
issues.detail: The Edit filing page shows a fixed '0 transactions selected' bar even with nothing selected, and it sits over the Last name field.
issues.evidence: Bar position fixed, top 756px, bottom 840px; Last name input top 830px (viewport 1440x900).

issues.title: Inline 'Manage' link looks like body text
issues.detail: In Payments settings, 'Control which email forwarding alerts you receive. Manage' renders Manage in the sentence's grey with no underline, while the Edit actions and the 1099 link elsewhere are blue.
issues.evidence: 'Manage' <a>: color rgb(195,195,204), text-decoration none. 'required to file a 1099' link and 'Edit' render blue in the screenshots.

issues.title: 'our Help Center.' link includes the sentence's period
issues.detail: Check deposit step 1 (guidelines) ends with 'More Questions? Check out our Help Center.' where the link text is 'our Help Center.', period included. The later check deposit steps could not be reached by direct URL during the sweep, so whether the same footer repeats there is unverified.
issues.evidence: DOM (2026-09-25) on /add-funds/check/guidelines: More Questions? Check out our Help Center.. Jev p=0.73 that the period belongs outside the link.
